headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Rafael Flores Jr. leading the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBI. The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas hitting two home runs and driving in three runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Sebastián Rivero (Los Angeles Angels), Vladimir Guerrero Jr. (Toronto Blue Jays), Abner Uribe (Milwaukee Brewers), Colt Emerson (Seattle Mariners), Davis Martin (Chicago White Sox), Matt Chapman (San Francisco Giants), Trevor McDonald (San Francisco Giants), and Garrett Whitlock (Boston Red Sox). The status of these players is uncertain, and their availability for upcoming games is unknown.

The Milwaukee Brewers acquired Jonathan Ornelas from the Athletics in exchange for cash, while the Baltimore Orioles received Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox as part of the Adley Rutschman trade. The Kansas City Royals also made a trade, acquiring Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with the Cubs' pitching staff shutting out the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Close Contest**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless relief.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 IP, 5 K, 2 ER, 2 BB, 4 H. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the charge at the plate. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, finalizing the score at 4-3. Impact hitters for the White Sox included Randal Grichuk and Andrew Benintendi, while Tristan Peters and Eduardo Valencia also made notable contributions.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with multiple players contributing to the win. Alec Burleson, Joshua Báez, Blaze Jordan, Pedro Ramírez, and Michael Conforto were among the impact hitters, while Michael McGreevy stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Rivero Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added infield depth with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, who was traded to the team from the Athletics for cash.
